cohort: 36,965 puerperal patients aged 14-52 years at 33-42 weeks' gestation who gave birth at Hassan II Hospital, Settat, Morocco between January 2009 and December 2013
finding: The cesarean section rate increased from 11.48% in 2009 to 14.76% in 2013, while the perinatal mortality rate decreased from 3.34% in 2009 to 2.24% in 2013.
